name: Who Wants to Be a Millionaire
description: Hosted by Jimmy Kimmel, celebrities play to win a million dollars for a charity of their choosing. Contestants have 15 questions to win a million dollars in this classic game show.

videos.title: In the Hot Seat: Eric Stonestreet and Will Forte
videos.overview: The 20th anniversary event kicks off with celebrity contestant Eric Stonestreet playing for Building Hope for Autism and Will Forte playing for The Pangea Network.

videos.title: In the Hot Seat: Will Forte and Nikki Glaser
videos.overview: Will Forte continues his winning streak this week in support of The Pangea Network. Nikki Glaser will play for Rescue the Birds, including a never-before-seen historic moment in the show’s 20-year history.

videos.title: In the Hot Seat: Nikki Glaser, Jane Fonda and Anthony Anderson
videos.overview: Nikki Glaser continues her winning streak for Rescue the Birds. Jane Fonda takes the stage in support of her charity Fire Drill Friday’s, and Anthony Anderson plays for The Anderson Family Foundation.

videos.title: In the Hot Seat: Anthony Anderson, Ike Barinholtz and Hannibal Buress
videos.overview: Anthony Anderson continues his streak playing for The Anderson Family Foundation. Ike Barinholtz jumps in the hot seat playing for Uplift Family Services, and Hannibal Buress plays for Melvina Masterminds.

videos.title: In the Hot Seat: Hannibal Buress and Catherine O’Hara
videos.overview: Hannibal Buress continues his run playing for Melvina Masterminds, while Catherine O’Hara steps up to play in support of Upward Bound House.

videos.title: In the Hot Seat: Catherine O’Hara and Dr. Phil
videos.overview: Catherine O’Hara continues her winning streak in support of Upward Bound House, and Dr. Phil plays in support of his charity When Georgia Smiled.

videos.title: In the Hot Seat: Dr. Phil, Kaitlin Olson and Lauren Lapkus
videos.overview: Dr. Phil continues his run in support of his charity When Georgia Smiled. Kaitlin Olson steps up to play for the Cystic Fibrosis Foundation, and Lauren Lapkus takes her shot at the grand prize for the Crohn’s & Colitis Foundation.

videos.title: In the Hot Seat: Lauren Lapkus and Anderson Cooper
videos.overview: Lauren Lapkus continues her shot at the grand prize for the Crohn’s & Colitis Foundation, and Anderson Cooper plays for the Spikes K9 Fund.

videos.title: In the Hot Seat: Anderson Cooper and Andy Cohen
videos.overview: Anderson Cooper continues his run on “Millionaire” for the Spikes K9 Fund and then swaps seats with Andy Cohen, filling in as his guest expert, as Cohen jumps in the hot seat for Planned Parenthood.

In the Hot Seat: Drew Carey & Aisha Tyler; Matt Damon & Ken Jennings
videos.overview: Drew Carey and Aisha Tyler take the hot seat; then—finally—we have time for Matt Damon as he teams up with Ken Jennings for a trivia throwdown.

videos.title: In the Hot Seat: Matt Damon & Ken Jennings; Jordan Klepper & Ronny Chieng
videos.overview: Matt Damon and Ken Jennings go for the million, and later, “The Daily Show” duo Jordan Klepper and Ronny Chieng put their knowledge to the test.

videos.title: In the Hot Seat: Joel McHale & Jim Rash; Tramell Tillman & Zach Cherry
videos.overview: “Community” duo Joel McHale and Jim Rash team up, while “Severance” stars Tramell Tillman and Zach Cherry try to sever the gap to one million.

videos.title: In the Hot Seat: Adam Devine & Anders Holm; Helen Hunt & Dan Bucatinsky
videos.overview: “Workaholics” duo Adam Devine and Anders Holm are in it to win it, then Helen Hunt and Dan Bucatinsky bring their “Hacks”-style humor to the hot seat.

videos.title: In the Hot Seat: Kal Penn & Jameela Jamil; Gary Janetti & Brad Goreski; Chloe Fineman & Jillian Bell
videos.overview: It’s a jam-packed episode as Kal Penn and Jameela Jamil, Gary Janetti and Brad Goreski, and Chloe Fineman and Jillian Bell take the hot seat.

videos.title: In the Hot Seat: Asif Ali & Saagar Shaikh; Joe Buck & Oliver Hudson
videos.overview: This week, it's “Deli Boys” stars Asif Ali and Saagar Shaikh, then the “Daddy Issues” duo Joe Buck and Oliver Hudson take their shot at the million.

videos.title: In the Hot Seat: Jake Tapper & Kaitlan Collins; Mike Birbiglia & Atsuko Okatsuka
videos.overview: “CNN”’s Jake Tapper and Kaitlan Collins test their smarts, and then comics Mike Birbiglia and Atsuko Okatsuka bring the laughs to the hot seat.

videos.title: In the Hot Seat: Sarah Silverman & Marc Maron; Oscar Nuñez & Kate Flannery
videos.overview: The season finale is packed: Sarah Silverman and Marc Maron and “The Office” stars Oscar Nuñez and Kate Flannery go for the million.

videos.title: In The Hot Seat: Larry David & Cazzie David; Ben Affleck & Jamie Ding
videos.overview: Larry David teams up with his daughter, Cazzie David, while Ben Affleck joins game show champion Jamie Ding, as the celebrity duos take the hot seat, test their trivia knowledge and compete to win up to $1 million for charity.

videos.title: In The Hot Seat: Ben Affleck & Jamie Ding; Jason Alexander & Wayne Knight; Tig Notaro & Pete Holmes
videos.overview: Ben Affleck and Jamie Ding go for the million; meanwhile, Jason Alexander reunites with his “Seinfeld” co-star Wayne Knight, and comedians Tig Notaro and Pete Holmes take their turn in the hot seat.

videos.title: In the Hot Seat: Brad Paisley & Clayton Kershaw; Michael Kosta & Wendi McLendon-Covey
videos.overview: Country music star Brad Paisley teams up with MLB legend Clayton Kershaw, followed by comedian Michael Kosta and actress Wendi McLendon-Covey.

awards: Nominated for 2 Primetime Emmys. 2 nominations total
